statement: The function returns a result r, len(r) = n, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, r[i] is true if and only if candies[i] + extraCandies >= candies[j] for every j with 0 <= j < n; equivalently, r[i] is true if and only if candies[i] + extraCandies >= M, where M is the maximum of candies[0..n-1].
preconditions: n = len(candies); 2 <= n <= 100; for every i with 0 <= i < n, 1 <= candies[i] <= 100; 1 <= extraCandies <= 50.
